5042:viXra The JET hybrid H-mode scenario from a pedestal turbulence perspective 2 1
Introduction: JET hybrid H-mode scenario The high-confinement mode (H-mode) is an attractive operating scenario for tokamak fusion devices [1, 2]
It is the default high-performance scenario of ITER [3] and other next-step fusion devices like SPARC [4]
At the JET tokamak, the H-mode scenario has been optimized in a particular kind of discharge, namely hybrid discharges [5, 6, 7, 8, 9]
Here, we present the first comprehensive characterization of gyrokinetic turbulent transport in a JET hybrid H-mode pedestal
These profile variations probe the sensitivity of our results and address the discussed questions on the reasons for the increased H-factor of hybrid discharges and its viability as an ITER scenario
